description: This file contains functions and procedures for managing NAND flash memory, including identifying, mounting, creating, removing UBI and UBIFS volumes, and performing firmware upgrade operations on NAND devices. It is part of the OpenWrt firmware upgrade system.

methods.name: nand_mknod
methods.description: Creates a device node in /dev for the specified directory if it does not already exist.

methods.name: nand_find_volume
methods.description: Finds the UBI volume basename based on device directory and volume name.

methods.name: nand_find_ubi
methods.description: Finds the UBI device associated with a partition name.

methods.name: nand_get_magic_long
methods.description: Reads the magic number from a NAND flash specified by filename.

methods.name: get_magic_long_tar
methods.description: Reads magic number from a tar archive.

methods.name: identify
methods.description: Identifies the file type based on its magic number.

methods.name: identify_tar
methods.description: Identifies the tar file type.

methods.name: identify_if_gzip
methods.description: Checks if the file is gzipped based on its magic number.

methods.name: nand_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration from a backup tarball to the NAND root filesystem.

methods.name: nand_remove_ubiblock
methods.description: Removes and unmounts a UBI block device.

methods.name: nand_attach_ubi
methods.description: Attaches a UBI partition, formatting if necessary, and returns the UBI device.

methods.name: nand_detach_ubi
methods.description: Detaches a UBI partition and cleans up associated volumes.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_prepare_ubi
methods.description: Prepares the UBI environment for upgrade by creating volumes and removing existing ones.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubinized
methods.description: Flashes a UBI image file to the device.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_ubifs
methods.description: Flashes a UBIFS image to the root filesystem volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_fit
methods.description: Updates a FIT image into a UBI kernel volume.

methods.name: nand_upgrade_tar
methods.description: Processes a tar archive to upgrade NAND partitions or UBI volumes.

methods.name: nand_verify_if_gzip_file
methods.description: Verifies if a gzipped file is valid.

methods.name: nand_verify_tar_file
methods.description: Verifies the integrity of a tar archive.

methods.name: nand_do_flash_file
methods.description: Detects file type and performs appropriate flashing/upgrading.

methods.name: nand_do_restore_config
methods.description: Restores configuration if a backup tarball exists.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for upgrading firmware from a file, handling all necessary steps.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_success
methods.description: Handles successful upgrade cleanup and reboot.

methods.name: nand_do_upgrade_failed
methods.description: Handles cleanup and reboot after failed upgrade.

methods.name: nand_do_platform_check
methods.description: Checks if the provided file is a valid update image for the device's platform.
